big_case.notes: A jurisdictionally defective pro se collateral suit in the Court of Federal Claims seeking non-monetary relief against the Federal Circuit Judicial Council's disciplinary order regarding Judge Pauline Newman, summarily affirmed below on settled Tucker Act grounds (28 U.S.C. § 1491(a)(1); United States v. Navajo Nation, 556 U.S. 287, 290 (2009)) and denied without response or dissent after the United States waived.
